item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Saturday Severe Update
item.description: Showers and thunderstorms rolling through the state on Saturday, March 7. A lot of the state is no longer under a severe threat, but flooding continues.

item.title: 1 dead, 1 arrested after Little Rock pursuit on Friday
item.description: One person was killed and another injured after a police pursuit in Little Rock, Arkansas, led to a crash, resulting in the arrest of 37-year-old Patrick Hardy on several charges, including capital murder.

item.title: Human remains found in remote area of Hot Spring County, sheriff says
item.description: The Hot Spring County Sheriff's Office is investigating after human remains were discovered in a remote part of the county, and the remains have been sent to the Arkansas State Crime Laboratory for identification.

item.title: GALLERY: Arkansas Travelers alumni participating in the 2026 World Baseball Classic
item.description: The 2026 World Baseball Classic will feature several current and former Arkansas Travelers, including Team USA's Cal Raleigh, Team Dominican Republic's Julio Rodríguez, Team Panama's Jose Caballero, Team Colombia's Michael Arroyo, Team Israel's Charlie Beilenson, Team Canada coach Stubby Clapp, and Team Great Britain's Harry Ford.

item.title: Central Arkansas beats Florida Gulf Coast, advances to ASUN tournament final
item.description: The Central Arkansas Bears men's basketball team won their ASUN semifinal game against Florida Gulf Coast University 73-63, earning a spot in the ASUN Championship game and a chance to make it to the Big Dance.

item.title: Central Arkansas Bears fall in overtime to Queens in ASUN championship game
item.description: The Central Arkansas Bears men's basketball team lost to Queens 96-90 in overtime in the ASUN Championship game, despite a 49-point performance by senior guard Camren Hunter, which broke the school record for points in a game.

item.title: Russellville couple accused of abusing 7-year-old now charged with theft
item.description: A Russellville couple accused of severely abusing their 7-year-old son now faces felony charges for misusing public assistance.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Blog: EF-2 tornado confirmed in Nevada County Saturday
item.description: On Saturday, March 7, from 5:37 a.m. to 5:45 a.m., an EF-2 tornado is confirmed to have occurred near Willisville in Nevada County, Arkansas. One person was injured in this tornado.

item.title: Community march in Little Rock honors anniversary of Bloody Sunday
item.description: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. — Community members gathered Sunday in Little Rock to commemorate the 61st anniversary of Bloody Sunday, which was a key event in the Civil Rights Movement when state troopers attacked peaceful marchers in Selma, Alabama, who were demanding voting rights. item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Monday's an Arkansas Storm Team Alert Day for severe weather
item.description: Monday, March 9, is an Arkansas Storm Team Alert Day for severe weather chances in central and southern Arkansas. Timing is around 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Monday. This kicks off a multi-day risk of severe weather in Arkansas as chances persist late Tuesday into Wednesday. Flooding is a growing risk, too.
